Tooltip_CeroSec_NoAccess: You cannot stand in front of this computer.
Tooltip_CeroSec_TooHigh: This computer is too high to reach.
Tooltip_CeroSec_NoFixture: This module does not fit here.
Tooltip_CeroSec_NoLock: This door has no lock worth wiring.
Tooltip_CeroSec_ManyDoors: A computer cannot work a double or garage door.
Tooltip_CeroSec_ModuleOutside: This has to be done from inside.
Tooltip_CeroSec_ModuleRecipe: Read the CeroSec Field Wiring Guide to learn how <LINE> to make one.
Tooltip_CeroSec_ModuleDesc_contact: Magnetic contact. The computer SEES this door or <LINE> window: a read-only doorN or winN. Electricity %1.
Tooltip_CeroSec_ModuleDesc_relay: Relay. The computer throws this light switch on and <LINE> off: a lightN. Electricity %1.
Tooltip_CeroSec_ModuleDesc_strike: Electric strike. The computer locks and unlocks this <LINE> door: a lockN beside its doorN. Electricity %1.
Tooltip_CeroSec_ModuleDesc_operator: Door operator. The computer opens and shuts this <LINE> door: a doorN it can write to. Electricity %1.
Tooltip_CeroSec_ModuleDesc_curtain: Curtain motor. The computer draws this curtain and <LINE> opens it: a curtainN. Electricity %1.
Tooltip_CeroSec_ModuleDesc_appliance: Appliance switch. The computer starts and stops this <LINE> oven, washer or dryer: a stoveN or washerN. Electricity %1.
Tooltip_CeroSec_ModuleDesc_window: Window operator. The computer raises and shuts this <LINE> sash: a windowN. It throws the catch and sets off a <LINE> house alarm doing it. Electricity %1.
Tooltip_CeroSec_ModuleDesc_genset: Generator switch. The computer starts and stops this <LINE> generator: a genN. It will not pull a cord. Electricity %1.
Tooltip_CeroSec_ModuleDesc_tuner: Tuner control. The computer switches this set on and <LINE> off and moves its dial: a tvN or an rxN. Electricity %1.
Tooltip_item_CeroSecCurtainMotor: Fits a curtain, or a door with a sheet on it. The <LINE> computer draws it and opens it.
Tooltip_item_CeroSecWindowOperator: Fits a window. The computer opens and shuts the sash -- <LINE> and it throws the catch and sets off a house alarm doing it.
Tooltip_item_CeroSecApplianceSwitch: Fits an oven, a microwave, a coffee machine, a washer or <LINE> a dryer. The computer starts it and stops it.
Tooltip_item_CeroSecGeneratorSwitch: Fits a generator. The computer starts it and stops it -- <LINE> it will not pull a cord, so a healthy generator only.
Tooltip_item_CeroSecTunerControl: Fits a television or a radio set. The computer switches it <LINE> on and off and moves the dial.
Tooltip_item_CeroSecSmallMotor: A small electric motor. The four things in Knox County <LINE> that have one are a hair dryer, sheep shears, a CD player <LINE> and a blower fan.
Tooltip_item_CeroSecWiringGuide: CeroSec Systems field handbook. Wiring diagrams and parts <LINE> lists for the four interface modules: magnetic contact, relay, <LINE> electric strike and door operator.
Tooltip_CeroSec_LinkDesc: Runs %1 tiles of electric wire to %2. That computer <LINE> sees this fixture on its own /dev. Unlinking gives the wire back.
Tooltip_CeroSec_UnlinkDesc: Takes the cable to %2 off this fixture and gives the <LINE> %1 electric wire back.
Tooltip_CeroSec_LinkFixture: Nothing of ours is fitted here.
Tooltip_CeroSec_LinkLinked: This computer is already on it.
Tooltip_CeroSec_LinkFar: Too far: a cable runs %1 tiles.
